title: BUDGET, MINISTRY OF NATIONAL DEVELOPMENT
html:
Sitting Date:12-03-1992
Title:BUDGET, MINISTRY OF NATIONAL DEVELOPMENT


Column: 1

BUDGET, MINISTRY OF NATIONAL DEVELOPMENT


    Mr Low Thia Khiang: They can take the 2-room flats and Singaporeans can be given the comfort of the 3-room flats.

    Mr Leong Horn Kee (Thomson) (In Mandarin) : Sir, I would like to make two suggestions to the Minister for National Development.

    The first concerns fire insurance for the HDB flats.
